title: Achraf Ellili appointed Group Chief Executive Officer of Dulsco Group
summary: His experience spans large-scale regional operations, business expansion and integration, supply chain management, operational excellence and workforce development

contentHtml:
Dulsco Group has announced the appointment of Achraf Ellili as Group Chief Executive Officer of the 91-year-old Emirati-founded, Dubai-based conglomerate. Image courtesy: Dulsco Group

His experience spans large-scale regional operations, business expansion and integration, supply chain management, operational excellence and workforce development

Press Release

Dubai, UAE: Dulsco Group has announced the appointment of Achraf Ellili as Group Chief Executive Officer of the 91-year-old Emirati-founded, Dubai-based conglomerate.

Ellili joins Dulsco Group having most recently served as Group Chief Executive Officer of a regional logistics company and brings more than 25 years of executive leadership built at the world’s largest logistics and supply chain companies. He previously held regional president, managing director and chief executive roles covering the Middle East, Africa and the Indian Subcontinent, with operational responsibility across more than 70 countries.

His experience spans large-scale regional operations, business expansion and integration, supply chain management, operational excellence and workforce development. Throughout his career he has focused on translating strategy into execution, strengthening performance and building organisations that balance customer value, operational discipline and long-term growth.

Achraf Ellili, Group Chief Executive Officer of Dulsco Group, said: “Dulsco has grown alongside the UAE since 1935, and few companies here can say the same. As we approach our centenary, my focus is on building on that foundation: investing in our people, in the systems and the discipline that help us serve our customers better, and in growth that endures. The legacy is remarkable. Our job now is to be worthy of it.”

Spokesperson for Dulsco Group’s Board of Directors, said: “Achraf brings a rare combination of extensive international leadership experience and operational depth, and a track record of turning strategy into delivery. Dulsco Group has set an ambitious course, and the Board is confident he is the right person to lead it.”

Ellili will lead a team of more than 25,000 people serving over 3,700 clients globally. Dulsco Group has evolved into a diversified business delivering people, environment, talent and specialist energy solutions that drive performance and productivity for its clients.

 Approaching the rare UAE milestone of a 100-year-old business, Dulsco Group continues to build on the foundations established by its Emirati founders while looking ahead to the opportunities that will shape its next century.

About Dulsco Group

Dulsco Group is a leading provider of workforce, people and environmental solutions with a portfolio of businesses comprising: Dulsco People, Dulsco Environment, Parisima and Advance Global Recruitment (AGR).

Founded in 1935 in the UAE as a workforce solutions provider, Dulsco Group has built a 91-year legacy of trust, service, and innovation. Over the decades, the Group has expanded its reach and diversified its offerings including the acquisitions of Parisima and AGR, enabling it to deliver end-to-end solutions to more than 3,700 clients across multiple sectors and over 80 countries worldwide. To know more click – www.dulsco.com.
